turns.teacher: Good morning children! Very good, everyone is sitting nicely. Today we will do subtraction. Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you said thirty five? No no, that is wrong. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Listen carefully. The answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everybody say it with me, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Very nice, lovely voices! Thumbs up if you understood. Good, so many thumbs!
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now try this one. Sixty one minus thirty four.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Arjoon, thirty seven is not correct. You must borrow. Borrow and then subtract. Borrow, then subtract!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: It is twenty seven. Sixty one minus thirty four is twenty seven. Write twenty seven in your notebook, Arjun.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Mina, you are counting on fingers again? Don't use fingers, it is too slow. Put your hands down.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: One more. Seventy three minus forty six. Quickly, everyone.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: The answer is twenty seven. Seventy three minus forty six is twenty seven. Who all got twenty seven? Hands up. Okay, good, good.
turns.label: tell_answer
